people.name: Adam
people.line: The first man, created by God

translations.web: So also it is written, “The first man, Adam, became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
translations.bsb: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being”; the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
translations.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
translations.asv: So also it is written, The first man Adam became a living soul. The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
